hook.line: Medicine on a high shelf, a goal that finally feels possible, a price you can afford: all of these are about whether you can reach something. Spanish uses *alcance* for the literal and the figurative.
hook.es: La solución está al alcance de la mano.

examples.es: Mantener fuera del alcance de los niños.
examples.en: Keep out of the reach of children.

examples.es: La solución está al alcance de la mano.
Estos precios están al alcance de cualquiera.
examples.en: These prices are within anyone's reach.

examples.es: El celular está a mi alcance.
examples.en: The phone is within my reach.

examples.es: Ese apartamento está fuera de mi alcance.
examples.en: That apartment is out of my reach.

examples.es: Las medicinas deben estar fuera del alcance de los niños.
examples.en: The medicines must be kept out of the reach of children.

rule:
*Alcance* is "reach", and a few fixed frames cover it:

*al alcance de la mano*: within arm's reach, or within easy grasp.

*al alcance de todos / de cualquiera*: affordable or available to everyone.

*a mi / tu / su alcance*: within my / your / his reach.

*fuera de mi alcance* or *fuera del alcance de…*: out of reach.

It works for real distance (*el celular está a mi alcance*) and for money or goals (*un carro está fuera de mi alcance*).

When the person is a noun, *de* joins the pieces: *fuera del alcance de los niños*. Remember *de* + *el* becomes *del*.
smallPrint: Teachers call these prepositional locutions. They are fixed frames, so learn each one whole.

readAndPick.es: La solución está al alcance de la mano.
options: The solution is within reach.
The solution is out of reach.
The solution is in my hand.

readAndPick.es: Ese apartamento está fuera de mi alcance.
options: That apartment is within my reach.
That apartment is out of my reach.
That apartment is far from the street.

readAndPick.es: Estos precios están al alcance de cualquiera.
options: These prices are out of anyone's reach.
These prices are known to everyone.
These prices are within anyone's reach.

readAndPick.es: El celular está a mi alcance.
options: The phone is within my reach.
The phone is out of my reach.
The phone is mine.

readAndPick.es: Mantener fuera del alcance de los niños.
options: Keep near the children.
Keep out of the reach of children.
Keep in the hands of children.

readAndPick.es: La victoria está al alcance de la mano.
options: The victory is out of reach.
The victory was a long time ago.
The victory is within reach.

readAndPick.es: El estante está fuera de mi alcance.
options: The shelf is out of my reach.
The shelf is within my reach.
The shelf is far from here.
Everything is out of your reach.
Everything is within your reach.
Everything is in your pocket.

yourTurn.prompt: Pick *a* or *fuera de* and type the sentence: *El celular está ___ mi alcance.* (it is within reach)
yourTurn.answer: El celular está a mi alcance.
yourTurn.why: Within reach is *a mi alcance*; *fuera de* would mean out of reach.

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish: That apartment is out of my reach.
yourTurn.answer: Ese apartamento está fuera de mi alcance.
yourTurn.why: Out of reach is *fuera de mi alcance*.

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish: The solution is within reach.
yourTurn.answer: La solución está al alcance de la mano.
yourTurn.why: *Al alcance de la mano* is the fixed frame for easy reach.

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish: These prices are within anyone's reach.
yourTurn.answer: Estos precios están al alcance de cualquiera.
yourTurn.why: *Al alcance de cualquiera* means affordable to all.

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish: Keep out of the reach of children.
yourTurn.answer: Mantener fuera del alcance de los niños.
yourTurn.why: Out of reach of someone is *fuera del alcance de* plus the people.

yourTurn.prompt: Make it about *you* (tú): *Todo está a mi alcance.* Say: Everything is within your reach.
Turn it around: *El estante está a mi alcance.* Say: The shelf is out of my reach.
yourTurn.answer: El estante está fuera de mi alcance.

pitfalls.wrong: Está fuera de el alcance de los niños.
pitfalls.right: Está fuera del alcance de los niños.

pitfalls.wrong: El celular está en mi alcance.
pitfalls.right: El celular está a mi alcance.
pitfalls.why: Almost. English "in my reach" tempts *en*, but Spanish uses *a*.

pitfalls.wrong: Estos precios están al alcance para todos.
pitfalls.right: Estos precios están al alcance de todos.
pitfalls.why: Almost. After *alcance* the link is *de*, not *para*.

personal: Think of one goal that feels within reach for you, and one thing that is out of reach for now. Say both with *alcance*.
